name: SiteStaffr – AI Chatbot and Voice Agent for WordPress
author: SiteStaffr

sections.description:
SiteStaffr adds an AI agent to your WordPress site. Visitors can type their question or speak it, and your agent answers 24/7 using what it knows from your own website pages. Every conversation is saved with a full transcript, an AI summary, and suggested follow-up, so nothing gets lost.

Text chat is unlimited on every paid plan, with no per-conversation fees. Voice is included on every plan too, so a visitor who would rather speak can do that on your website instead of calling. When a visitor leaves their name and their email or phone, the lead lands in your inbox.

No phone lines. No code. Install in minutes. Free for 30 days.

AI Text Chat

  • Unlimited AI text chat on every paid plan, with no per-conversation fees
  • A chat widget on every page, for the visitors who would rather type than call
  • Answers drawn straight from your own website content
  • Takes down a visitor’s name and their email or phone without sending them to a form

Voice Agent

  • Visitors can talk to your agent without leaving your website
  • No phone call to place, no number to set up, nothing for them to install
  • 10 AI voices to match how your business sounds
  • Contact details are captured mid-conversation, the same as in chat

AI Knowledge Base

  • Sync your website pages so your agent answers from your own content
  • Finds the right page even when a visitor asks in their own words
  • Your agent learns your business, so there is nothing to script

Built for Business

  • 57+ languages, so visitors get answers in the language they use
  • Full conversation transcripts stored in WordPress
  • An AI summary and suggested follow-up after every conversation
  • Email alerts with one-click access to the transcript
  • A usage dashboard showing conversations, leads, and voice minutes
  • Change how the widget looks: colors, position, border styles, and icon

Also Included

  • Blog Agent writes SEO blog posts for your site, grounded in your business, ready for you to review before they publish
  • AI Visibility checks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini mention your business when people ask about your field

Two Widget Styles

  • Fixed-position widget with text chat and voice
  • Inline button variant via [sitestaffr_button] shortcode

Great For

  • Dental practices
  • Medical practices
  • Med spas and aesthetics
  • Chiropractic and physical therapy
  • Veterinary clinics
  • Law firms
  • Accounting and tax
  • Insurance agencies
  • Real estate
  • Home services
  • HVAC and plumbing
  • Pest control
  • Auto repair shops
  • Salons and barbershops
  • Fitness studios
  • Any WordPress business that wants its website answering 24/7

External Services

This plugin relies on SiteStaffr cloud services and third-party infrastructure providers to deliver chat, voice, AI, and billing features.

SiteStaffr Cloud Service (Required)
* Purpose: Site registration, authenticated chat and voice session orchestration, post-conversation processing, and AI blog content generation (manual and scheduled Autopilot posts, including topic suggestions)
* Data sent: Site URL, installation identifier, business context/settings, transcript text, and usage metadata required to deliver service features. For blog generation: the post topic/keyword, your business name and description, titles/URLs/short excerpts of your published pages and the internal link targets of your recent generated posts, drafts included (for internal linking and link variety), and your site’s category/tag names. Generated posts are delivered directly back to your site and are not stored on SiteStaffr servers.
* Privacy Policy: https://sitestaffr.com/privacy
* Terms of Service: https://sitestaffr.com/terms

OpenAI (Required via SiteStaffr service)
* Purpose: Text chat replies, real-time voice conversation, AI-generated summaries, and AI blog content/image generation
* Data sent: Chat messages, voice audio during active sessions, transcript text, and prompt context needed to generate responses/summaries; for blog posts, the topic and business context needed to research and write the article
* Provider Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Stripe (Required for paid plans and add-ons)
* Purpose: Subscription billing, checkout, and payment management
* Data sent: Billing identifiers, plan/add-on selection, and payment-related metadata
* Provider Policy: https://stripe.com/privacy

Google Cloud (Required infrastructure)
* Purpose: Hosting and secure operation of SiteStaffr cloud services
* Data sent: Service requests and operational metadata required to process authenticated plugin requests
* Provider Policy: https://cloud.google.com/privacy

Data Handling
* Transcripts and conversation metadata are stored in your WordPress database
* Configuration/auth metadata is stored for service operation
* Audio recordings are not persisted by this plugin

By using this plugin, you acknowledge relevant conversation and session data is transmitted to SiteStaffr cloud services to provide functionality.

Privacy

SiteStaffr processes visitor conversation data to provide chat and voice agent functionality.

Data may include:
* Visitor contact details (if provided)
* Transcript text
* Session timing and usage metrics
* Business configuration you enter in settings

SiteStaffr does not use your data for advertising.

Plans & Free Trial

SiteStaffr includes a 30-day free trial so you can try every feature before you pick a plan.

After your trial, choose the plan that fits your site:

  • Free Trial: full access for 30 days
  • Starter: unlimited text chat plus everyday voice, for smaller sites
  • Business: unlimited text chat plus more voice minutes, for growing sites
  • Pro: unlimited text chat plus our most voice minutes, for busy sites

Every paid plan includes unlimited AI text chat with no per-conversation fees. What changes between plans is the voice minutes they include. Optional add-ons can add more voice minutes and more knowledge pages.

Visit sitestaffr.com for current pricing and plan details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sitestaffr/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress
  3. Go to SiteStaffr in wp-admin
  4. Complete setup and connect your site
  5. Add the widget shortcode to a page and test a conversation
sections.faq:
How does SiteStaffr work?

Visitors click the widget on your site and start a text or voice conversation. SiteStaffr’s AI uses your synced website content to answer their questions. After each conversation, you get a transcript, a summary, and suggested follow-up in your WordPress admin.

Is this a chatbot or a voice agent?

Both, in one widget. Most visitors type, so text chat is unlimited on every paid plan with no per-conversation fees. Anyone who would rather talk can do that on your site, using the voice minutes your plan includes.

Will I be charged per conversation?

No. Text chat is unlimited on every paid plan and is never billed per conversation. Voice is the part that varies by plan, and it is measured in voice minutes.

Do I need a phone number or any other accounts?

No. Visitors talk to your agent on your own website, so there is no call to place and no number to set up. You do not need your own OpenAI account either, because the AI is included in your plan.

How does the AI know about my business?

You sync your website pages from the AI Knowledge page in wp-admin. SiteStaffr learns your content so the AI can answer questions about your services, pricing, hours, and more.

What languages does it support?

SiteStaffr supports 57+ languages for both text and voice conversations. Visitors can type or speak in their preferred language.

Can I customize the widget appearance?

Yes. You can change colors, position, border styles, icon, and choose between a fixed widget or an inline button. There are also 10 different AI voices to match your brand.

Is audio recorded?

No. Audio is not stored by this plugin. Conversation transcripts are saved in your WordPress database for your records.

Does the widget show SiteStaffr branding?

No. The widget does not display any SiteStaffr branding text.

Is there a free trial?

Yes. SiteStaffr includes a free 30-day trial so you can test it on your site before committing to a plan. Visit sitestaffr.com for pricing details.
sections.changelog:
1.41.1 – 2026-08-13

  • Fixed: The voice minute add-on now shows its current price of $20 for 60 minutes. wp-admin had kept advertising $10 for 50 minutes, so the buy window quoted less than you would actually be charged. The running total as you change the quantity was affected too, not just the first line.

1.41.0 – 2026-08-12

  • Added: After-hours conversations on Usage & Billing — the share of conversations that arrived while you were closed, including how many of them were qualified leads.
  • Added: Top pages on Usage & Billing — which pages start conversations, and which ones produce qualified leads.
  • Added: Both appear in your shareable usage report, so you can hand the proof to your team or agency without giving them a login.
  • Fixed: Plan prices and included voice minutes in wp-admin now match current pricing — Starter $29 (100 voice minutes), Business $69 (300), Pro $129 (600), each with unlimited AI text chat. The Usage & Billing page and the setup wizard had kept showing the old figures.

1.40.3 – 2026-08-11

  • Fixed: Cancelling no longer sends you an email saying a payment failed. If you cancel a site on purpose, nothing has gone wrong and there is nothing to fix — so you now hear nothing. That email is only sent when a payment genuinely fails and your agent stops because of it.
  • Fixed: Sites on a complimentary plan are no longer told their agent has paused when it is answering normally.

1.40.2 – 2026-08-10

  • Fixed: Voice conversations are no longer over-counted when a visitor leaves the page open. If someone started a voice chat, switched to another tab and closed their browser hours later, all of that idle time could be counted against your minutes. Only the conversation itself counts now.

1.40.1 – 2026-08-10

  • Fixed: A blog post that fails partway through writing no longer loses its topic. The topic returns to your Upcoming Topics list and is written on the next run, instead of disappearing.

1.40.0 – 2026-08-10

  • Security: Links to conversation transcripts now expire. The “view conversation” link in your notification emails used to work forever, for anyone who had it — so a forwarded email or an old mailbox left a private conversation readable indefinitely. New links last 30 days, and the share link on a conversation lasts 14 days. Every email sends a fresh one.
  • Security: If a transcript link is ever shared somewhere it shouldn’t have been, every outstanding link can now be switched off at once — including your leads page link, which previously could not be switched off at all. Ask SiteStaffr support to do this; there is no button for it yet. Your leads link changes when they do, and the new one arrives in your next lead notification email.
  • New: You’ll now be emailed if your agent stops answering visitors. If a payment fails, a trial ends, or you run out of minutes, your agent pauses — and until now the only place that showed was the WordPress dashboard. It’s easy to miss, because a paused agent doesn’t look broken: visitors still see your contact form and you still get their messages, they just don’t get answers. You now get one email telling you exactly what happened and a button to fix it without logging in, and another when your agent is answering again. One email per problem, not a daily nag.
  • New: You can now choose what you get emailed about. Under My Agent → Notifications, “Email Me About” lets you pick every conversation (the default, unchanged) or qualified leads only — conversations where the visitor left a name plus a phone number or email. Either way every conversation still appears in your dashboard; this only changes what lands in your inbox.
  • Security: Transcript links sent to Salesforce now expire after 30 days instead of 90, matching the links in your own emails.
  • Fixed: You can now re-sync a lead that already reached Salesforce. Previously only failed leads could be retried, so if the conversation link in a Salesforce record ever stopped working there was no way to refresh it.
  • Note: Links in emails sent before this update keep working until 30 September 2026, so nothing breaks in your inbox today. After that they show a short page explaining that the link has expired and where to find the conversation instead.

1.39.3 – 2026-08-08

  • Fixed: Your AI is much more likely to get a caller’s email address right. Once someone had given a name and a phone number, the AI treated the message as finished — so if they offered an email later in the call, it was taken down without being spelled back or confirmed. Callers who carefully spelled their address out could still end up in your inbox with it wrong by a letter, and the AI would keep re-checking details it already had instead of noting the new questions they’d asked. It now returns to taking details properly whenever something is still missing.
  • Fixed: On a call, the AI no longer reads the dashes in a phone number out loud when it repeats it back to a caller.
  • Fixed: A trial that runs out mid-visit no longer leaves the chat window silently doing nothing. Visitors now see the contact form straight away instead of waiting on a widget that had stopped responding.

1.39.2 – 2026-08-06

  • Fixed: Your AI is less likely to finish taking a message before it has a phone number or email. Behind the scenes it is given a running note of which of a visitor’s details it has collected so far — but when it had none yet, that note was left out altogether instead of saying “nothing yet”. A voice agent could read the silence as “everything is already on file” and wrap up early, leaving you a lead with a name and no way to reach the person. It now says so plainly.

1.39.1 – 2026-08-04

  • Fixed: Chat answers can no longer show broken link text. If the AI didn’t have a real page URL to work from, it could still write link markup — which reached visitors as raw brackets like “Patient Images” rather than anything clickable. That now renders as ordinary text, and the AI is no longer asked for a link when your site hasn’t given it one to use.
  • Changed: Links in chat answers open in the same tab instead of a new one.
  • Added: When a visitor follows a link from the chat, the conversation record now reads “Visitor clicked a link” instead of “Visitor left” — so you can tell someone who took up a suggestion apart from someone who simply left.

1.39.0 – 2026-07-29

  • Added: Your AI can now answer “where can I find that?” with a real link. When a visitor asks where something lives on your site — a gallery, a form, a service page — the chat replies with a clickable link to the actual page instead of describing where to look. Links come only from your site’s own pages; the AI can never invent a URL.

1.38.0 – 2026-07-28

  • Added: Your Business Profile now tells you when it has fallen behind your site. Publish a new page — a new location, a new service, a new product — and Settings shows a note next to Generate Profile saying how many new pages your profile hasn’t seen yet. Regenerating stays your call; nothing is ever overwritten automatically. Blog posts deliberately don’t trigger it, so a site running Blog Agent on autopilot isn’t nagged every week.
  • Fixed: Pages built from a theme template can now be linked to by the Blog Agent. Pages whose content lives in a PHP template — typical for landing and feature pages — report no words to WordPress, so the Blog Agent read them as empty stubs and would never link to them. They now carry the text already stored in your knowledge base, falling back to the page’s SEO description.
  • Fixed: The Blog Agent gathers link candidates as recent posts and recent pages separately, so on a site that publishes frequently your evergreen pages no longer age out of the list within weeks.
  • Fixed: Hand-editing your Business Profile now records when it changed. Previously only AI generation did, which would have made every manually written profile look permanently out of date to the new note above.

1.37.0 – 2026-07-27

  • Added: Native Salesforce integration — connect your org once from Settings → Integrations and every qualified lead your AI captures is pushed to Salesforce automatically, with name, contact details, what they wanted, and a link back to the conversation. No Zapier or middleman service required.
  • Added: Per-lead sync status on the Conversation Details → Captured Lead card, with a Retry action for any lead that didn’t make it across.
  • Changed: The integration stays completely inert until a site connects — no extra work for sites that don’t use Salesforce. Disconnecting is one click and stops the push immediately.
  • Fixed: A blip from the Salesforce status endpoint no longer causes a lead to be silently dropped.
  • Note: Salesforce shows a “Security Warning” on its consent screen for any app distributed outside AppExchange. This is expected, and the Connect card explains it beforehand.

1.36.4 – 2026-07-24

  • Fixed: Blog Agent — a post delivered via the pull fallback no longer reports as a failed generation. When a host’s bot protection refused the signed push, you were shown a raw “Delivery failed” error even though the pickup cron imported the finished post minutes later. The job now waits for the pickup instead of reporting failure.

1.36.3 – 2026-07-24

  • Fixed: Voice — the AI no longer talks over visitors who are dictating contact details. Turn-taking sensitivity is now lower while collecting contact info (visitors pause mid-recall when giving digits or spelling an email address) and unchanged everywhere else.

1.36.2 – 2026-07-23

  • Added: AI Visibility “Suggest prompts” — proposes fresh prompts to track, targeted at the queries where competitors are beating you (based on your latest check’s misses and competitor list). Review and add the ones you want.

1.36.1 – 2026-07-23

Cleaner, denser, and consistent with the rest of the admin. New sites get a “Run first check” button instead of a blank card.

  • Fixed: Text chat now aborts a hung or stalled request after 30 seconds with a clear “please try again” message, instead of leaving the visitor staring at a typing indicator. Re-armed on each streamed chunk, so slow-but-alive responses are never cut off.

short_description: AI chatbot and voice agent for your site. It answers visitors day or night, captures their name and email or phone, and emails you the lead.
description:
SiteStaffr adds an AI agent to your WordPress site. Visitors can type their question or speak it, and your agent answers 24/7 using what it knows from your own website pages. Every conversation is saved with a full transcript, an AI summary, and suggested follow-up, so nothing gets lost.

Text chat is unlimited on every paid plan, with no per-conversation fees. Voice is included on every plan too, so a visitor who would rather speak can do that on your website instead of calling. When a visitor leaves their name and their email or phone, the lead lands in your inbox.

No phone lines. No code. Install in minutes. Free for 30 days.

AI Text Chat

  • Unlimited AI text chat on every paid plan, with no per-conversation fees
  • A chat widget on every page, for the visitors who would rather type than call
  • Answers drawn straight from your own website content
  • Takes down a visitor’s name and their email or phone without sending them to a form

Voice Agent

  • Visitors can talk to your agent without leaving your website
  • No phone call to place, no number to set up, nothing for them to install
  • 10 AI voices to match how your business sounds
  • Contact details are captured mid-conversation, the same as in chat

AI Knowledge Base

  • Sync your website pages so your agent answers from your own content
  • Finds the right page even when a visitor asks in their own words
  • Your agent learns your business, so there is nothing to script

Built for Business

  • 57+ languages, so visitors get answers in the language they use
  • Full conversation transcripts stored in WordPress
  • An AI summary and suggested follow-up after every conversation
  • Email alerts with one-click access to the transcript
  • A usage dashboard showing conversations, leads, and voice minutes
  • Change how the widget looks: colors, position, border styles, and icon

Also Included

  • Blog Agent writes SEO blog posts for your site, grounded in your business, ready for you to review before they publish
  • AI Visibility checks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini mention your business when people ask about your field

Two Widget Styles

  • Fixed-position widget with text chat and voice
  • Inline button variant via [sitestaffr_button] shortcode

Great For

  • Dental practices
  • Medical practices
  • Med spas and aesthetics
  • Chiropractic and physical therapy
  • Veterinary clinics
  • Law firms
  • Accounting and tax
  • Insurance agencies
  • Real estate
  • Home services
  • HVAC and plumbing
  • Pest control
  • Auto repair shops
  • Salons and barbershops
  • Fitness studios
  • Any WordPress business that wants its website answering 24/7

External Services

This plugin relies on SiteStaffr cloud services and third-party infrastructure providers to deliver chat, voice, AI, and billing features.

SiteStaffr Cloud Service (Required)
* Purpose: Site registration, authenticated chat and voice session orchestration, post-conversation processing, and AI blog content generation (manual and scheduled Autopilot posts, including topic suggestions)
* Data sent: Site URL, installation identifier, business context/settings, transcript text, and usage metadata required to deliver service features. For blog generation: the post topic/keyword, your business name and description, titles/URLs/short excerpts of your published pages and the internal link targets of your recent generated posts, drafts included (for internal linking and link variety), and your site’s category/tag names. Generated posts are delivered directly back to your site and are not stored on SiteStaffr servers.
* Privacy Policy: https://sitestaffr.com/privacy
* Terms of Service: https://sitestaffr.com/terms

OpenAI (Required via SiteStaffr service)
* Purpose: Text chat replies, real-time voice conversation, AI-generated summaries, and AI blog content/image generation
* Data sent: Chat messages, voice audio during active sessions, transcript text, and prompt context needed to generate responses/summaries; for blog posts, the topic and business context needed to research and write the article
* Provider Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Stripe (Required for paid plans and add-ons)
* Purpose: Subscription billing, checkout, and payment management
* Data sent: Billing identifiers, plan/add-on selection, and payment-related metadata
* Provider Policy: https://stripe.com/privacy

Google Cloud (Required infrastructure)
* Purpose: Hosting and secure operation of SiteStaffr cloud services
* Data sent: Service requests and operational metadata required to process authenticated plugin requests
* Provider Policy: https://cloud.google.com/privacy

Data Handling
* Transcripts and conversation metadata are stored in your WordPress database
* Configuration/auth metadata is stored for service operation
* Audio recordings are not persisted by this plugin

By using this plugin, you acknowledge relevant conversation and session data is transmitted to SiteStaffr cloud services to provide functionality.

Privacy

SiteStaffr processes visitor conversation data to provide chat and voice agent functionality.

Data may include:
* Visitor contact details (if provided)
* Transcript text
* Session timing and usage metrics
* Business configuration you enter in settings

SiteStaffr does not use your data for advertising.

Plans & Free Trial

SiteStaffr includes a 30-day free trial so you can try every feature before you pick a plan.

After your trial, choose the plan that fits your site:

  • Free Trial: full access for 30 days
  • Starter: unlimited text chat plus everyday voice, for smaller sites
  • Business: unlimited text chat plus more voice minutes, for growing sites
  • Pro: unlimited text chat plus our most voice minutes, for busy sites

Every paid plan includes unlimited AI text chat with no per-conversation fees. What changes between plans is the voice minutes they include. Optional add-ons can add more voice minutes and more knowledge pages.

Visit sitestaffr.com for current pricing and plan details.
